contentHtml:
In the next episode of Quem Ama Cuida, Pedro (Chay Suede) and Adriana (Leticia Colin) believe they have found proof of the physical therapist's innocence, but the couple's hopes are dashed when Adélia reveals that her house was burglarized and the belongings left by Dalto, the forensics expert linked to Adriana's case, have disappeared. The robbery raises suspicions and could make it harder to uncover what really happened during the investigation into the death of Arthur (Antonio Fagundes).

Diná visits Francesca's grave

Meanwhile, Diná (Rosi Campos) tries to better understand her mysterious connection to Arthur's family. She seeks out Edvaldo (Guilherme Piva) to find out how she entered the businessman's life. Later, Otoniel (Tony Ramos) observes Diná visiting Francesca's (Nathalia Dill) grave and, visibly moved, the physical therapist apologizes to the deceased woman, deepening the mystery surrounding her past.

Pilar and Iuri in conflict

Pilar (Isabel Teixeira) crosses the line with Iuri (José Loreto) once again. The businesswoman demands that the security guard perform a private fashion show exclusively for her, putting the young man in an embarrassing situation.

Ingrid encourages Brigitte to investigate

Ingrid (Agatha Moreira) encourages Brigitte (Tata Werneck) to investigate what really happened between Pilar and her father. The conversation further sparks the waitress's curiosity about the secrets kept by her family.

Ademir and Dora's tie

Ademir (Dan Stulbach) picks up the tie found on the couch at Dora's (Mariana Ximenes) house. The object reinforces his suspicions and could put him on the path to the truth about his ex-wife's closeness with André (Henrique Barreira).

New encounters and twists

Tiago (Gui Ferraz) invites Bruna (Fernanda Marques) to dinner, paving the way for a new phase in the young woman's life. Meanwhile, Ulisses and Lyris exchange compliments that lead to a kiss, and Suely receives a plea for reconciliation from Ademir, who is trying to rekindle their relationship. The episode promises to shake up the relationships and legal proceedings in the telenovela's plot, which airs Monday through Saturday at 9:20 PM on Globo.

With information from UOL, Capricho.
